symbols.name: triple indicator vector
symbols.meaning: The indicator vector of the triple S, the 0-1 vector with a one in each position of S.
symbols.quote: The complex construction reads its overlaps from [Indicator vector](indicator-vector.md)s, since $|S\cap T|=t_S^{\mathsf T}t_T$, where $t_S$ is the indicator vector of $S$.

symbols.name: extra central wire
symbols.meaning: The extra central wire that gathers the sum of all source values.
symbols.quote: Its auxiliary wires are side wires $W_{ST}$, one for each ordered neighbouring pair $(S,T)$, central wires $C_\ell$ for $\ell\in[h]$, and an extra central wire $C_*$.

symbols.name: central coefficient
symbols.meaning: The central coefficient of x_T in y_S, equal to (|S ∩ T| − 1)/2.
symbols.quote: The coefficient $\varpi_{ST}=\tfrac12(|S\cap T|-1)$ is the central coefficient of $x_T$ in $y_S$.

symbols.name: total wire count
symbols.meaning: The total number of wires in the complex construction.

symbols.name: smaller-call count
symbols.meaning: The total number of smaller calls, the recursive calls made on the edges.
symbols.quote: Let $s_c$ be the total number of smaller calls.

symbols.name: bank entry count
symbols.meaning: The number of entries in each data bank, v^3.
symbols.quote: Each bank has $N=v^3$ entries, one wire each.

symbols.name: triple count
symbols.meaning: The number of triples, the binomial coefficient of h choose 3.
symbols.quote: Let $v=\binom h3$ be the number of triples; the letter $v$ changes meaning here.

symbols.name: neighbour count
symbols.meaning: The number of neighbours of a fixed triple in the complex construction.
symbols.quote: Each has $vz_c$ side wires and $c_c$ central wires, where $z_c$ is the number of neighbours of a fixed triple.

symbols.name: central wire count
symbols.meaning: The number of central wires in each invocation of the complex construction.
symbols.quote: Each has $vz_c$ side wires and $c_c$ central wires, where $z_c$ is the number of neighbours of a fixed triple.

symbols.name: label dimension
symbols.meaning: The dimension of the label space, h^3.
symbols.quote: The letter $m$ changes meaning here: it is the dimension of the label space, $m=h^3$.

symbols.name: dimension lost
symbols.meaning: The dimension lost on the central-wire edges of the complex construction.
symbols.quote: $L_c$ is the dimension lost on central-wire edges.

relations.quote: The complex construction is a variant of the [Subset-intersection network](subset-intersection-network.md) that takes its scalars from [Gaussian dyadics](gaussian-dyadics.md), so that it exchanges two banks of values exactly.

The complex construction is a variant of the [Subset-intersection network](subset-intersection-network.md) that takes its scalars from [Gaussian dyadics](gaussian-dyadics.md), so that it exchanges two banks of values exactly.
The complex construction reads its overlaps from [Indicator vector](indicator-vector.md)s, since $|S\cap T|=t_S^{\mathsf T}t_T$, where $t_S$ is the indicator vector of $S$.
The complex construction changes the neighbour rule of the [Bit construction](bit-construction.md) and keeps its copy step.
